summary: Gorax showcases the updated end-game Aura team for Temporal Vortex featuring new heroes Annelisis and Holfast. The video details hero builds, artifact options, positioning, alternate support choices, and exact 18-second skill timing rotations. Replacing Lincos with Holfast allows Aura teams to reach over 10 billion damage, outperforming top-tier Toxin teams in single-target bosses.

heroes.name: Annelisis
heroes.note: Enhances Aura allies, dispels buffs, and boosts overall team damage; build with high HP for survival in Temporal Vortex.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Replaces Lincos in Aura lineups, providing passive Aura energy gain and teamwide damage buffs even at Inspiration 0.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Primary damage dealer built with maximum HP, Crit Rate, and Crit Damage using mythic gear and Golden Alarm.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Provides secondary damage and utility; build with accuracy, crit stats, and HP.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Provides persistent shields and damage reduction using Puppeteer set and Aurelium Vest.

teams.note: End-game Aura team capable of dealing over 10 billion damage using an 18-second skill rotation.

meta_changes: Holfast replaces Lincos as the best Aura buffer/enabler, outperforming Lincos even at low inspiration levels.
Aura teams now surpass high-inspiration Toxin teams in single-target damage output like Temporal Vortex.
tips: Position Annelisis behind Talethia in season deployment layout.
Build maximum HP on Annelisis to balance target priority and keep Talethia alive longer.
Use an 18-second recast cycle for the entire team, starting pet skills 2 seconds before Talethia.
If Solmo is unavailable, substitute with other Radiance supports like Rena, Ardreth, Gillian, or Acilia.
title: Annelisis + Holfast Change the Aura Meta! New Team Showcase | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
